prompt: Implement a Merchant Engagement & Settlement Analytics Console for offline-first marketplace operations and internal auditing. The desktop app targets Windows 11 (1920x1080 minimum with high-DPI scaling) and is packaged as a signed .msi installer. Roles include Administrator, Analyst, Moderator, and Finance Operator. The UI is built as an Electron desktop shell with a Svelte-based dashboard and multi-window workflow. Core capabilities include a local visualization and query service (Fastify REST APIs), advanced analytics, moderation, engagement features, and offline-first data persistence in PostgreSQL.
